title: Multi-SF RX absent: gateways/nodes MUST receive on SF7-SF12; SHOULD advertise capability (spec 02 3.4/3.5)
description: Reqs R-02-019, R-02-020, R-02-025. NOT-IMPLEMENTED. Evidence: C Kconfig placeholder only (lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/Kconfig:198-205 LICHEN_GATEWAY_MULTI_SF default n, no scan code; comments lora_l2.c:289-296); C RX programs a single datarate (lora_l2.c:298-308); rust lichen-hal/lichen-embassy have no SF-scan surface; python sim medium.py has no SF dimension at all so orthogonality/multi-SF RX cannot be simulated. Also blocks R-02-021 cross-SF forwarding via gateway. Suggested placement: C lr1110/lora_l2 CAD multi-SF scan (gateway first), rust lichen-embassy RX scheduler, python sim medium SF dimension; capability bit in DIO.
